output.summary: A sprawling perennial herb native to the western Mediterranean, from southwestern France through the Iberian Peninsula to the Azores, Morocco and Algeria. It grows in damp ground or water and overwinters underwater in its native habitat. In Portugal, the whole plant, fresh or dried, is added to stews, salads, soups, cheeses and sauces, and used in liqueur infusions.
output.edibilityNote: In Portugal, the whole plant is used fresh or dried in savoury foods and in liqueur infusions.
